post.description: Validates the request, checks brief compatibility and preferences, then reserves the estimate and queues the job. Mismatches return 422 with field-level guidance; a check outage returns 503. Neither reserves credits.

patch.description: Requires a manage-scoped API key or a dashboard owner/admin. Defaults are off. Renew explicit consent before enabling, changing charge scope or resuming paused automatic top-ups. Disabling remains available when payment capability is unavailable.

post.description: Creates a hosted card setup with no credit purchase. Requires manage scope. Card details appear only after a signed provider confirmation; saving does not enable automatic top-ups.
Creates a fresh hosted provider portal session for this organisation. Requires manage scope and an existing billing customer.

delete.description: Disables this card in Classive and turns off linked automatic top-ups. Requires manage scope. Does not delete the payment provider’s records or undo a charge already sent.

RateLimitLimit.description: Requests allowed a minute for this key.

BadRequest.description: invalid_request: the body or a parameter is not valid; error.details lists each problem.

Unauthorized.description: unauthorized: no Authorization header, or the key is unknown or revoked.

InsufficientCredits.description: insufficient_credits: the balance is less than the job would reserve.

Forbidden.description: forbidden: the organisation is suspended, or the signed-in dashboard user’s role does not allow it.

NotFound.description: not_found: no such resource for this organisation.

Conflict.description: conflict: the Idempotency-Key was already used with a different request.

TooLarge.description: too_large: the body is over 1 MB (35 MB for materials), or a material is over 25 MB.

Unprocessable.description: unprocessable: valid but cannot be done (a refused preference, a material without readable text, a job that cannot be revised or built on).

RateLimited.description: rate_limited: too many requests this minute.

Unavailable.description: unavailable: something we depend on is not available just now; try again shortly.

video.description: How the narrated explanation should be.

captions.description: How the caption text is written.

notes.description: How the notes are laid out or phrased.

Preferences.description: Style only. Each is checked before the job is accepted; one that does not belong in a learning result is refused with 422 and a reason ([GET /v1/preferences/examples](https://classive.app/api#tag/catalogue/getPreferenceExamples)).

prompt.description: The teaching task, in your own words. Describe the topic, goals, examples and approach within the selected type and settings. Checked for compatibility before credits are reserved. Strings are trimmed before their lengths are checked.

goals.description: What a learner should be able to explain or do afterwards.

materials.description: Ids of your own materials with readable text ([POST /v1/materials](https://classive.app/api#tag/materials/uploadMaterial)).

outputs.description: All four when omitted. A video always comes with WebVTT and SRT captions.

voice.description: A voice id from [GET /v1/voices](https://classive.app/api#tag/catalogue/listVoices); the default narrator when omitted.

basedOn.description: A completed clip or lesson job of your organisation that was made with video; its script is reused.

title.description: Taken from the prompt when omitted.

lessons.description: When omitted we choose; the estimate assumes defaultCourseLessons ([GET /v1/prices](https://classive.app/api#tag/catalogue/getPrices)).

totalMinutes.description: Must allow 3–20 minutes per requested lesson.

prompt.description: Optional review focus. Omit or leave blank for accuracy, clarity, audience fit and goal coverage. Returned as an empty string when omitted.

goals.description: What a learner should be able to explain or do afterwards.

CreateJobRequest.description: Creates a clip, lesson or review. Courses require an approved curriculum version and /v1/curricula/{id}/generate. Unknown fields are refused with 400; direct aggregate courses with 422.

AcceptedJobInput.description: Stored accepted input, including historical aggregate course jobs. New courses use the approved curriculum route.

prompt.description: What should change, and why it helps the learner.

url.description: GET it with your API key (not a public link).

lessons.description: One per lesson, by order; empty for a review.

estimatedCompletionAt.description: Our estimate while queued or processing, worked out again as the job goes; null once finished.

percent.description: Null before a stage is known; estimated for written work when estimated is true; 100 only once delivered.

estimated.description: True for written estimates based on actual milestones and bounded time within the current stage.

progress.description: Where the job is. Absent when it failed.

credits.description: Base-rate estimate; confirm the full maximum charge with a quote.

stages.description: In the order writing, visuals, voice, rendering, checks; only the stages used. Empty until the job completes.

retentionDays.description: 0 retains until deleted; omitted uses deployment default.

previewUrl.description: Public audio sample for this voice; playback does not create a job.

avoid.description: Examples of what is refused, each with the reason.

prices.description: The current price of each item in credits, and the defaults used for course estimates. The items and amounts can change: read them rather than copying them.

prefix.description: The first characters of the key.

kind.description: Separate credential namespace. Only signed-in owners/admins can mint MCP keys.

prefix.description: The first characters of the key.

key.description: Shown only in this response. MCP credentials work only at /mcp; API credentials work only at /v1.

kind.description: Separate credential namespace. Only signed-in owners/admins can mint MCP keys.

name.description: Trimmed and cut to 80 characters; “API key” when empty.

kind.description: Separate credential namespace. Only signed-in owners/admins can mint MCP keys.

secret.description: The signing secret, shown only in this response.

url.description: https, on a public host name (no IP addresses, localhost or internal names). At delivery the host must resolve to public addresses.

events.description: All supported events when omitted or empty. Select explicit events for a narrower subscription.

amountUsd.description: Whole US dollars of credit value. Hosted checkout shows any additional processing fee before payment. Read the current range from [GET /v1/billing/packs](https://classive.app/api#tag/billing/listPacks).

savePaymentMethod.description: Explicitly ask hosted checkout to save the card for later use; does not enable automatic top-ups.

checkoutUrl.description: The hosted checkout to send the payer to.

paymentEnvironment.description: Stored environment of this purchase; does not change when the account switches to live payments. Historical purchases without an environment report unavailable.

field.description: A dotted path, such as audience.band or goals.1.

id.description: The same on every delivery attempt; use it to skip repeats.

url.description: A PNG file of the job.

markdown.description: Figures appear as Markdown images under their section headings.

NotesFile.description: The contents of a notes.json file.

type.description: For example multiple-choice, true-false or short-answer.

correctAnswer.description: The index of the correct option (from 0), or the answer as text.

QuizFile.description: The contents of a quiz file.

FlashcardsFile.description: The contents of a flashcards file.

ReviewFile.description: The contents of a review file.

id.description: A saved payment-method id returned by [GET /v1/billing/settings](https://classive.app/api#tag/billing/getBillingSettings).

monthlyMaximumUsd.description: Maximum automatic card-charge exposure in a UTC calendar month, including unsettled attempts. Must be at least amountUsd.

paymentMethodId.description: A saved payment-method id returned by [GET /v1/billing/settings](https://classive.app/api#tag/billing/getBillingSettings).

canAutoTopup.description: True only when saved USD card charging and Classive-absorbed processing fees have been verified. Availability does not enable charging.

paymentMethodId.description: A saved payment-method id returned by [GET /v1/billing/settings](https://classive.app/api#tag/billing/getBillingSettings).

agree.description: Required to enable, change charge scope, or resume paused automatic top-ups. Unchanged settings preserve the prior consent.

id.description: A saved payment-method id returned by [GET /v1/billing/settings](https://classive.app/api#tag/billing/getBillingSettings).
A saved payment-method id returned by [GET /v1/billing/settings](https://classive.app/api#tag/billing/getBillingSettings).

BillingEventData.description: Billing events carry alert, top-up or masked payment-method data instead of a job. No card number or security code is included.

fundingVersion.description: New video quotes use a fixed requested-minute price, preserved through acceptance and delivery.

id.description: Stable file identity; an instructor answer key adds an answer-key suffix.
